author_story_spine.title: Start with pre‑computed dense passage embeddings from a standard retriever (e.g., Contriever) and the query embedding
author_story_spine.author_statement: Start with pre‑computed dense passage embeddings from a standard retriever (e.g., Contriever) and the query embedding from the same encoder. Augment each passage embedding with a document ID embedding (relative to the current retrieved set) and a sinusoidal passage‑position encoding to inject structural cues. Process the query and enriched passage embeddings jointly through a stack of Transformer encoder layers that use a hybrid attention mechanism: a shared full attention module for global interactions, and a dedicated masked attention module that restricts attention to passages from the same document, to consolidate intra‑document coherence. Optimize the model with a contrastive loss (InfoNCE) that uses the fixed original query embedding as an anchor, pulling the contextualized positive passage embedding closer and pushing negatives away. At inference, compute dot‑product similarity between the static query embedding and the updated passage embeddings, then rank passages in descending order of these scores.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: Motivation: efficiency and cross‑passage inference challenges in existing rerankers.
Embedding‑based reranking formulation and overall framework.
Architecture details: enriching embeddings with document ID and position, the Transformer encoder with hybrid attention (shared full + dedicated masked).
Training objective: InfoNCE loss with fixed query anchor.
Inference procedure.
Avoid full‑text processing and autoregressive generation to reduce inference latency.
Inject document‑level structural knowledge into passage embeddings to support cross‑passage inference.
Design two complementary attention patterns that co‑exist in each layer: global and document‑local.
Use relative, dynamic document ID assignments rather than global corpus‑level IDs.
Keep the query embedding fixed during training and inference while updating passage embeddings.
Train on ConTEB datasets that explicitly require cross‑passage reasoning.

Improve reranking in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems by addressing both inference efficiency and the need for cross-passage reasoning, especially when evidence is scattered across passages and requires resolving coreference or structural context.
author_intent_unverified_points.reason: At least one typed behavior target is partially or fully covered; remaining targets need additional evidence or an explicit gap.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: Contriever: Dense retriever that provides initial passage embeddings and top‑k retrieval.
author_intent_unverified_points.reason: Every typed target has a matching fact, but no authorized atomic claim is bound to this authoring obligation.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: passage embeddings (pi): Fixed dense representations of candidate passages obtained from Contriever.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: document ID embedding table: Learned relative document‑identity embeddings assigned dynamically to unique documents in the candidate set, enabling the model to recognize which passages belong together.
author_intent_unverified_points.reason: Every typed target has a matching fact, but no authorized atomic claim is bound to this authoring obligation.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: passage position encoding (sinusoidal): Encodes the position of a passage within its original document, providing structural order cues.
author_intent_unverified_points.reason: Every typed target has a matching fact, but no authorized atomic claim is bound to this authoring obligation.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: hybrid attention mechanism: Combines shared full attention (global cross‑passage) and dedicated masked attention (intra‑document) in each Transformer layer to jointly model inter‑ and intra‑document dependencies.
author_intent_unverified_points.reason: Every typed target has a matching fact, but no authorized atomic claim is bound to this authoring obligation.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: shared full attention module: Standard multi‑head attention allowing query and all passages to attend to each other; captures global relevance and cross‑document relationships.
author_intent_unverified_points.reason: Every typed target has a matching fact, but no authorized atomic claim is bound to this authoring obligation.

author_intent_unverified_points.statement: dedicated masked attention module: Masked multi‑head attention that restricts a passage to attend only to the query and to other passages from the same document, enabling fine‑grained coreference resolution and local coherence.
author_intent_unverified_points.reason: Every typed target has a matching fact, but no authorized atomic claim is bound to this authoring obligation.
